headline: Wirtz finally scores —
9th to 6th on the forfeit table
body: 10 weeks later, Florian Wirtz scores his first goal of the season. 51 points this week keeps his lead where it is, yet that's almost not even the table he's looking at. Lewis-Potter gets one week before Mitoma replaces him, and Mitoma's debut is spent on the bench.
The Heung Min boys drag themselves up from 9th on the forfeit table to 6th. A sigh of relief. The rest of the league is starting to catch on though, and the boys are right on his ahh.

headline: 51 again —
start the right keeper, Umar
body: 51 seems to be the number this week. Doesn't gain anything on Imad, but definitely a safe week. Dewsbury-Hall's 9 and Le Fée's 11 tell us he doesn't even need Haaland. Scary times.
Whenever Umar decides to start taking draft seriously and start the right keeper, he might actually be dangerous.

headline: Los Porros lives in the heat —
new blood incoming
body: Slight midweek scare, falling to 4th, but Los Porros lives in the heat. No João Pedro yet, so Szobo and Vuskovic take matters into their own hands. Branthwaite, picked up after Imad let him go, chips in 3 on debut.
43 points, decent. Looking to revamp the squad, though, with some departures and, in turn, new blood.

headline: 113 in a fortnight —
then reality checks in
body: Two weeks as the hottest side in the league and Chennaiyin finally cool off. 35 points, second-worst of the week, and Thiago somehow finds a way to go minus with -2. N. Jackson's 11 does the heavy lifting, and last week's pickup Hill adds 4.
Fourth place survives by a single point, with Split the G right behind him and Barry in form. One more week like this and he's looking at it from below.

headline: Barry 16 —
a point off fourth
body: Thierno Barry decides it's his week: a brace and an assist against Coventry, max bonus, 16 points. The biggest haul in the league, and Split the G sit one point behind Vidhun.
The Flemming saga rumbles on, though. Dropped for Welbeck, brought back for Welbeck, and rewarded with a bench seat and a 0. At some point he has to pick one and commit.

headline: 59, top of the week —
green arrow to 6th
body: Three starters don't kick a ball and Asspine still post the top score of the week. The bench comes on for 12, McGinn finally turns up with 10 and Cherki adds 9. 59 points and up to 6th.
McGinn was the man he dropped Bruno Fernandes for, and Bruno scored 10 for Sandaru this week. Honours even, for now. Dulaj is right there, and Munir knows it.

headline: 49 points —
and a red arrow anyway
body: Delap bags a brace against City for 13 and Ødegaard pulls the strings for 11. Most weeks 49 moves you up. This week Munir posts 59 and Arsene Fection drop to 7th.
Still no waiver claims, the only manager in the league without one in the last two windows. Either complete faith in the squad, or he's never found the button.

headline: Defence 29 —
attack 1
body: Roefs 9, Konsa 8, last week's pickup Castagne 7. The Pakason back line does everything this week. Up top, Igor Jesus and Solanke manage 1 between them.
So naturally, both of Ometh's new waiver claims are defenders: Khusanov gets 1 and Acheampong 0 on the bench. 39 points and still 8th. Someone has to tell him which end the problem is at.

headline: Already ran the 10k —
the big one's lurking
body: Lowest score of the week with 34, and Trafford's 10 sits on the bench while Lammens starts in goal for 1. Nine points left in the dugout. New signing Matheus N., the man Sandaru binned a week ago, manages 1.
Samithu has already done one forfeit, the 10k. Sandaru is now 7 points behind him on the overall table, and finishing 10th means the big forfeit. His calves are nervous.

headline: An hour staring at a wall —
two gameweeks to dodge it
body: Next mini forfeit: an hour staring at a wall. Right now Saddam Huijsen are last on the forfeit table and Sandaru's the one booked in, with two gameweeks left to get out of it.

Bruno Fernandes, Munir's cast-off, was a smart pickup with 10 on debut. Kluivert adds 3, Mbaye is gone after one week, and the overall gap to 9th is down from 14 to 7. Progress. The wall is still favourite, though.
